messages:
anya: Opening a tiny PR to add minimal anonymized audit-log examples (Node, Go, curl) + one-line retention note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7642
mike: Keep examples <6 lines. Add pseudonymization note and telemetry fields that are OK (model_id, event, latency). Use env var REDWOOD_AUDIT_URL.
jamal: I'll add Node + curl snippets. Will show user_id as pseudonym_xyz and leave hashing lib unspecified.
lucy: I'll add a short retention sentence and link to the compliance playbook.
sara (Legal): Avoid the word "delete". Prefer "redact or pseudonymize" and include a legal-hold override mention. I'll review once text is in.
anya: Assigning: jamal (snippets), lucy (retention + link), mike (final edits + merge after legal), sara (legal signoff). Target: EOD tomorrow.
docs-bot: Preview will be available after PR is pushed.
